source.text:
// This source code is subject to the terms of the Mozilla Public License 2.0 at https://mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/
// © mabonyi

//@version=4
study("Liquidation Levels", shorttitle = "Liq Levels", overlay = true)



i_nonlinear = input(true, group = "Formula", title = "Nonlinear Contract (e.g. COIN-M)", type = input.bool)
i_maintmargin = input(0.05, group = "Formula", title = "Maintenance Margin above Liquidation", type = input.float)
maint_margin = 1 - i_maintmargin

i_x1 = input(5, group = "Leverage", title = "Level #1", type = input.float)
i_x2 = input(10, group = "Leverage", title = "Level #2", type = input.float)
i_x3 = input(20, group = "Leverage", title = "Level #3", type = input.float)
i_x4 = input(50, group = "Leverage", title = "Level #4", type = input.float)
i_x5 = input(100, group = "Leverage", title = "Level #5", type = input.float)
//i_x6 = input(20, group = "Leverage", title = "Level #6", type = input.float)
//i_x7 = input(25, group = "Leverage", title = "Level #7", type = input.float)
//i_x8 = input(50, group = "Leverage", title = "Level #8", type = input.float)
//i_x9 = input(75, group = "Leverage", title = "Level #9", type = input.float)
//i_x10 = input(100, group = "Leverage", title = "Level #10", type = input.float)
//i_x11 = input(125, group = "Leverage", title = "Level #11", type = input.float)

i_showlast = input(1, group = "Display", title = "Only Show Last X Bars (0 = all)", type = input.integer)
i_offset = input(0, group = "Display", title = "Projection offset", type = input.integer)
i_label_offset = input(5, group = "Display", title = "Level Label Offset", type = input.integer)

i_show_longs = input(true, group = "Labels", title = "Show long levels", type = input.bool)
i_show_shorts = input(true, group = "Labels", title = "Show short levels", type = input.bool)
i_show_x1 = input(true, group = "Labels", title = "Show Level 1 Labels", type = input.bool)
i_show_x2 = input(true, group = "Labels", title = "Show Level 2 Labels", type = input.bool)
i_show_x3 = input(true, group = "Labels", title = "Show Level 3 Labels", type = input.bool)
i_show_x4 = input(true, group = "Labels", title = "Show Level 4 Labels", type = input.bool)
i_show_x5 = input(true, group = "Labels", title = "Show Level 5 Labels", type = input.bool)

c_x1 = input(color.aqua, group = "Colours", title = "Level 1 Colour", type = input.color)
c_x2 = input(color.lime, group = "Colours", title = "Level 2 Colour", type = input.color)
c_x3 = input(color.yellow, group = "Colours", title = "Level 3 Colour", type = input.color)
c_x4 = input(color.orange, group = "Colours", title = "Level 4 Colour", type = input.color)
c_x5 = input(color.red, group = "Colours", title = "Level 5 Colour", type = input.color)

f_leveraged(_price, _x) =>
    _xlong = i_nonlinear ? _x + 1 : _x
    _xshort = i_nonlinear ? _x - 1 : _x
    _liq_long = _price * (1 - (1/_xlong * maint_margin))
    _liq_short = _price * (1 + (1/_xshort * maint_margin))
    [_liq_long, _liq_short]

f_print(_y, _txt, _c) =>
    t = time_close + ((i_offset + i_label_offset) * timeframe.multiplier * 60 * 1000)
    var _lbl = label.new(t, _y, _txt, xloc.bar_time, yloc.price, color.white, label.style_none, _c, size.small)
    label.set_xy(_lbl, t, _y)
    label.set_text(_lbl, _txt)


[x1_long, x1_short] = f_leveraged(close, i_x1)
[x2_long, x2_short] = f_leveraged(close, i_x2)
[x3_long, x3_short] = f_leveraged(close, i_x3)
[x4_long, x4_short] = f_leveraged(close, i_x4)
[x5_long, x5_short] = f_leveraged(close, i_x5)

plot(x1_long, title = "L1 Long", color = c_x1, offset = i_offset, show_last = i_showlast)
plot(x2_long, title = "L2 Long", color = c_x2, offset = i_offset, show_last = i_showlast)
plot(x3_long, title = "L3 Long", color = c_x3, offset = i_offset, show_last = i_showlast)
plot(x4_long, title = "L4 Long", color = c_x4, offset = i_offset, show_last = i_showlast)
plot(x5_long, title = "L5 Long", color = c_x5, offset = i_offset, show_last = i_showlast)

plot(x1_short, title = "L1 Short", color = c_x1, offset = i_offset, show_last = i_showlast)
plot(x2_short, title = "L2 Short", color = c_x2, offset = i_offset, show_last = i_showlast)
plot(x3_short, title = "L3 Short", color = c_x3, offset = i_offset, show_last = i_showlast)
plot(x4_short, title = "L4 Short", color = c_x4, offset = i_offset, show_last = i_showlast)
plot(x5_short, title = "L5 Short", color = c_x5, offset = i_offset, show_last = i_showlast)

plotchar(10e10, "", "")

// Print value on last bar only, so code runs faster.
if barstate.islast
    if i_show_longs
        if i_show_x1
            f_print(x1_long, str.format("+{0}x: {1}", i_x1, x1_long), c_x1)
        if i_show_x2
            f_print(x2_long, str.format("+{0}x: {1}", i_x2, x2_long), c_x2)
        if i_show_x3
            f_print(x3_long, str.format("+{0}x: {1}", i_x3, x3_long), c_x3)
        if i_show_x4
            f_print(x4_long, str.format("+{0}x: {1}", i_x4, x4_long), c_x4)
        if i_show_x5
            f_print(x5_long, str.format("+{0}x: {1}", i_x5, x5_long), c_x5)
    if i_show_shorts
        if i_show_x1
            f_print(x1_short, str.format("-{0}x: {1}", i_x1, x1_short), c_x1)
        if i_show_x2
            f_print(x2_short, str.format("-{0}x: {1}", i_x2, x2_short), c_x2)
        if i_show_x3
            f_print(x3_short, str.format("-{0}x: {1}", i_x3, x3_short), c_x3)
        if i_show_x4
            f_print(x4_short, str.format("-{0}x: {1}", i_x4, x4_short), c_x4)
        if i_show_x5
            f_print(x5_short, str.format("-{0}x: {1}", i_x5, x5_short), c_x5)

inputs.name: Only Show Last X Bars (0 = all)
